tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch one complete source block from the synthetic fixture. A scheduled transient error is recoverable by retrying this same tool. Tool failures and calls are logged. Both successful sources are required before calculate.

tools.name: calculate
tools.description: Validate successfully fetched data and write evidence.json: unranked source-specific KPIs, completeness, arithmetic, stable numeric evidence references, and warnings. Does not select findings or generate reports.

tools.name: render
tools.description: Read report.json and write canonical report.md without generating or changing the narrative.

tools.name: saved-report
tools.description: Execute the full deterministic baseline: fetch with recoverable retries, validate, calculate, select findings, create report.json, and render report.md. Only arm E has this complete-report shortcut.
